title: Disproving and Correcting the Distance Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian Brouwer-Type Conjectures
description:
This deposit contains the complete, formally verified refutation (Lean 4, 18 theorems, zero sorry, zero external dependencies), an exhaustive census of all 994 non-isomorphic connected graphs of order n <= 7, publication-quality figures, and a structural correction of two published spectral graph theory conjectures:

  • Alhevaz, Baghipur, Ganie and Pirzada (2021): M_k^Q(G) <= W(G) + binom(k+2,3) fails for connected non-path graphs.
  • Zhou, Wang and Chai (2025): U_r(G) <= W(G) + binom(r+2,3) fails for connected graphs.

Main results: (i) an exhaustive n <= 7 census with all violations listed; (ii) a simultaneous Theta(n^3) refutation on paths P_n (n >= 9), broom trees B(n-2,2) (n >= 10) and lollipops L(3,n-3) (n >= 12), with asymptotic excess at least (sqrt(3)/2 - 5/6) n^3 ~ 0.032692 n^3; (iii) the corrected universal theorem U_r(G), M_r^Q(G) <= W(G) + D binom(r+1,2), where D = diam(G), verified with zero counterexamples over the full census; (iv) the corrected bounds are formally proved in Lean 4.
